selected_script.angle: Absurd grandfather in full retro scuba diving gear swoops into the kitchen with the UFORU steam cover to rescue rubbery, moisture-drained reheated chicken wings.
selected_script.hook: Close-up of a rubbery, tough chicken wing popping and shriveling under harsh microwave heat, losing all moisture.
scene_order: 3-6s: Water added and cover placed over wings
14-18s: Lifting cover to reveal juicy chicken wings

script_record.pain_point: Reheated chicken wings turning rubbery, dry, and popping messy grease across the microwave.
script_record.conflict_hook: Scuba granddad bursts in wearing bright yellow vintage scuba goggles and a snorkel, carrying the UFORU splatter cover.
script_record.product_solution: Adding fresh water to the transparent side reservoir to keep food juicy while catching grease splatters.

timeline.scene: Close-up shot of dry chicken wings popping and spitting grease inside a dirty microwave without a cover.

timeline.purpose: 荒诞成年亲属携产品入场
timeline.scene: An absurd grandfather dressed in vintage scuba gear enters holding the transparent UFORU cover with olive-green rim and says, 'Keep it juicy!'
Granddad pours water into the clear side reservoir and places the dome cover directly over the plate of wings inside the microwave.
Fast-cut of the transparent dome trapping splatter as gentle internal steam circulates over the wings during reheating.
Fast-cut showing excess steam condensation flowing along the lower rim drainage channel and pouring cleanly out of the lower spout.
Fast-cut of granddad lifting the cover by its upper rear olive-green handle, revealing perfectly juicy, steaming chicken wings.
Text overlay and voiceover: 'Keep every meal juicy and clean. Get yours today.'

script_record.cta: Keep every meal juicy and clean. Get yours today.
